 Wolverhampton vs. Charlton - Head-to-head record
 Wolverhampton Wanderers and Charlton Athletic have not met competitively since December 2015. Their previous encounters therefore offer some historical context, although both clubs have undergone significant changes over the past decade.
 Wolves hold a narrow advantage in their last six meetings , with two victories compared with Charlton’s one. The other three matches ended in draws, highlighting how closely contested this fixture has been.
 Wolverhampton won their last two encounters in 2015, including a 2-0 away victory in December. However, recent form is likely to be a more reliable indicator ahead of Saturday’s Championship clash.

 Wolverhampton - Riding a wave of momentum
 Wolverhampton Wanderers have established themselves among the Championship’s leading contenders. César Peixoto’s side will be looking to extend their unbeaten run and maintain the pressure on the teams above them.
 Recent form
 Wolves sit fourth in the Championship with 28 points from 15 matches, just one point behind leaders Birmingham City . They have collected 14 points from their last six league fixtures, recording four victories and two draws.
 Their latest result was a 1-1 draw away to Wrexham before the international break. Although Wolves were unable to secure another victory, they have conceded no more than one goal in any of their last six matches.
 Wolves have also been difficult to beat at Molineux, winning four and drawing two of their seven home league fixtures. However, they have scored only once in four of their last five home matches, suggesting their attacking performances could improve.
 Peixoto faces several selection concerns, with Fer López and Jean-Ricner Bellegarde doubtful after missing international duty through injury. Jordan James remains sidelined, while Kieran Trippier, Yerson Mosquera and Hugo Bueno could return to the starting XI.

 Charlton - Hoping to build momentum
 Charlton Athletic finally ended their lengthy winless run before the international break. Nathan Jones’s side will now be hoping to build on that result, although their away record remains a concern.
 Recent form
 Charlton sit 17th in the Championship after their 2-1 home victory over Sheffield United on 7 November. That result ended an 11-match winless run in the league, stretching back to late August.
 Before that victory, Charlton had suffered four consecutive defeats against Watford, Norwich, Middlesbrough and Bolton. Their defensive problems were particularly evident in the 3-0 loss to Middlesbrough and the 3-1 home defeat against Norwich.
 The visitors have won just one of their seven away Championship fixtures this season, conceding 16 goals in the process. However, that solitary victory came against West Ham United, showing they are capable of producing surprising results.
 Jones could make changes following the victory over Sheffield United, with Matty Godden pushing for a starting place after scoring the winner as a substitute. Oliver Skipp and Harvey Knibbs are also in contention for recalls.

 Predictions for Wolverhampton vs. Charlton - home side to dominate
 Wolverhampton have been in excellent form, collecting 14 points from their last six league matches. Their strong home record gives them a clear advantage, making a first-half lead an appealing possibility against struggling Charlton.
 The visitors have conceded 16 goals in seven away Championship fixtures, highlighting their defensive problems. Wolves have the attacking quality to exploit those weaknesses, suggesting that a match featuring over 2.5 goals is another option worth considering.
 Although Wolverhampton have not always been prolific at Molineux recently, their consistency and Charlton’s poor away record make them strong favourites. Our main prediction is Wolverhampton -1.5 Asian Handicap , requiring the hosts to win by at least two goals.
